body_long:
Gault&Millau holds its 2026 gala on Monday 9 November at the Carrousel du Louvre in Paris, where it will present its 2027 national trophies.

The theme of the evening is Food is Art, linking gastronomy, art and creativity. Around 1,600 guests are expected at the ceremony and cocktail reception, and 600 at the dinner, which will be cooked by Jérôme Banctel, chef of Le Gabriel at La Réserve Paris.

## The trophies

The 28 nominees for the 2027 national awards were unveiled on 28 September. They compete in seven categories: Young Talent, Rising Star, Front-of-House Manager, Sommelier, No-Low Sommelier, Pastry Chef and Chef of the Year. According to Yonder, the Chef of the Year nominees include two chefs working in hotels: Jérôme Banctel of Le Gabriel at La Réserve Paris, and Julien Roucheteau of La Réserve de Beaulieu.

Several trophies are new this year: No-Low Sommelier of the Year, which honours non-alcoholic and low-alcohol pairings; Illustrator of the Year; Restaurant Designer of the Year; and a Champagne Design Trophy for visual identity.

## The signal

Hotel restaurants are firmly back in the gastronomic conversation. With two Réserve chefs among the Chef of the Year nominees, the evening will also be a moment for the hotels that invest in fine dining as part of their identity.

We will publish the winners after the ceremony.
